shared_elements: sinuous snake-like body with incised scale/hatch pattern
justification: Both are weathered pale stone works bearing creature imagery stacked vertically, and each includes an elongated sinuous body with incised cross-hatching plus a rounded animal-like head, which is the most specific correspondence. The decisive difference is technique and format: A is a flat slab with shallow low-relief figures organised into horizontal registers, while B is a fully three-dimensional sculpture in the round dominated by a frontal face and projecting limbs, so the visual impression and spatial logic are quite unlike.
